specifications.name: MS-OXMSG
specifications.pinStatus: Exact revision and retrieval baseline recorded on 2026-07-23; no retained hash-pinned publication is in the DOC-R00 bundle, so fixture publication remains blocked pending the owning MSG provenance gate.

recognitionPrecedence: Validate each candidate top-level container before interpreting its owned profile.
Retain every independently strong supported-format match; never use filename, media type, confidence or directory order to select a parser.
Reject multiple strong top-level or CFB profile matches as deterministic ambiguity without invoking a parser.
Dispatch one strong match, then classify its format family and acquisition subtype.
Classify a valid unrelated container as UnsupportedFormat and malformed bytes for an identified container or format profile as Corrupt.

profilePredicates.name: CompoundFileContainer
profilePredicates.minimumIdentificationEvidence: Bytes 0..7 equal D0 CF 11 E0 A1 B1 1A E1.
profilePredicates.strongMatch: The complete bounded MS-CFB header, DIFAT, FAT, MiniFAT, directory tree, parent ownership and referenced stream chains validate.
profilePredicates.identifiedFailure: After the exact eight-byte signature, any failed required CFB invariant is Corrupt; fewer than eight matching leading bytes do not identify CFB.

profilePredicates.name: ModernWordBinary
profilePredicates.minimumIdentificationEvidence: P001 strongMatch plus a root stream named WordDocument whose length is at least 2 and whose first little-endian UInt16 is 0xA5EC.
profilePredicates.strongMatch: Minimum evidence plus a complete DOC-R01 FIB envelope, coherent effective nFib/count layout, and the root 0Table or 1Table stream selected by fWhichTblStm.
profilePredicates.identifiedFailure: Once minimum evidence is present, truncation at byte 2 or later, contradictory FIB counts/version fields, an illegal pnNext state, or a missing selected Table stream is WordBinary/Corrupt. A root WordDocument shorter than 2 bytes is only an unrelated CFB profile and is UnsupportedFormat.

profilePredicates.name: UnverifiedLegacyWord
profilePredicates.minimumIdentificationEvidence: P001 strongMatch plus a root stream named WordDocument whose length is at least 2 and whose first little-endian UInt16 is exactly 0xA59B, 0xA59C, 0xA5DB or 0xA5DC.
profilePredicates.strongMatch: The minimum evidence is the entire identification predicate; no modern FIB or Table invariant is applied.
profilePredicates.identifiedFailure: Return UnsupportedFeature without product-version attribution or payload parsing. Any other marker is not a legacy Word identification.

profilePredicates.name: OutlookItem
profilePredicates.minimumIdentificationEvidence: P001 strongMatch plus a root stream named __properties_version1.0 of at least 32 bytes whose bytes 0..7 and 24..31 are zero.
profilePredicates.strongMatch: Minimum evidence plus bytes after 32 forming complete 16-byte property entries; root recipient and attachment storage names having their exact prefixes plus eight hexadecimal digits; and declared recipient and attachment counts equalling those root child counts.
profilePredicates.identifiedFailure: Once minimum evidence is present, an incomplete property entry, malformed owned child-storage name or declared/actual count disagreement is OutlookItem/Corrupt. The name with a shorter or invalid fixed header is only an unrelated CFB profile and is UnsupportedFormat.

profilePredicates.name: EncryptedOpenXml
profilePredicates.minimumIdentificationEvidence: P001 strongMatch plus root streams named EncryptionInfo and EncryptedPackage; EncryptionInfo is at least 4 bytes and EncryptedPackage is at least 8 bytes.
profilePredicates.strongMatch: EncryptionInfo begins with an MS-OFFCRYPTO version tuple: standard (major 2, 3 or 4; minor 2) with a bounded complete binary header/verifier; extensible (major 3 or 4; minor 3) with only fExternal set and a bounded complete provider descriptor/verifier; or agile (major 4; minor 4) followed by reserved UInt32 0x00000040 and bounded secure XML. EncryptedPackage begins with its little-endian UInt64 StreamSize and has non-empty bounded encrypted data; padding may make the physical encrypted data longer than StreamSize. Extensible provider URLs are recorded but never retrieved.
profilePredicates.identifiedFailure: Once both named streams and their minimum lengths exist, an unknown/truncated version grammar, invalid agile reserved value, invalid bounded XML/binary header, zero encrypted-data body or impossible checked length is EncryptedOpenXml/Corrupt. Name-only or shorter streams are a valid unrelated CFB profile, not Encrypted.
